title: Creator Permission Allowlist
description: Ledger of creators who have explicitly granted permission to clip/reuse their content. This file documents the contract; it is enforced in code by pipeline/permissions/validate.py.

creator_id.description: Unique, stable slug used to reference this creator elsewhere in the pipeline.

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the creator's channel/profile that clips will be sourced from.

permission_scope.description: What was actually permitted, e.g. 'clipping and reuse with commentary, non-monetized'.

permission_granted_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the permission was granted.

evidence.description: Reference to where the permission grant is documented (email thread, message link, contract doc, etc.).

expiry_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date after which this permission is no longer valid.

conditions.description: Optional restrictions or conditions attached to the permission.
